//: Foundry MCP servers (endpoint trust: stdio = loopback by construction, no network surface; allowlisted/enumerated here, not auto-discovered). Merges with the consuming repo's .mcp.json.

foundry-graph.//env: a recorded design decision: pin the graph path so the subprocess never falls through to a phantom cwd/.foundry/graph.json. Claude Code expands ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} in a plugin-provided .mcp.json env value at config-parse time (and also sets CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in the spawned server env), so this resolves to the consuming workspace's absolute graph path.
